# LearnQuest visual blocks

<!-- Generated by `pnpm --filter @learnquest/ui-catalog gen`. Do not edit. -->

A visual is one JSON object: `{"v": 1, "blocks": [...]}`.

- `blocks` holds 1 to 12 blocks, each `{"type", "id", "props"}` with no other keys.
- `id` is unique in the spec and matches `^[a-z0-9_]{1,24}$`.
- `props` takes only the keys listed for its type. Every visual block needs `alt` text.
- The whole spec is at most 65536 bytes.
- These types are reserved and never available: `run`.

## Blocks

### chart

At most 4 per spec.

Use `chart` to show numbers: `kind` is bar, line, scatter or function. `alt` is required: say what the chart shows. Optional `xLabel` and `yLabel` (up to 40 chars) name the axes.
bar, line and scatter take `series`: up to 4, each {label, optional color, points}, with up to 60 points {x, y}. For line and scatter x is a number; for bar x may be a short text category. `color` is a theme name (ink, green, green-deep, blue, sun, pink, lilac, mint, paper).
function takes `expr` instead (up to 80 chars), plotted as y in terms of x, with optional `xMin`/`xMax` (default -10 to 10), optional `color`, and up to 2 `sliders` {id, label, min, max, optional value} whose ids can be used in expr (ids must not be x or a function name).
expr allows only numbers, x, slider ids, + - * / ^, parentheses, unary minus, and sin cos tan sqrt abs exp log (one argument) and min max (two arguments). Nothing else: no other names, text, or symbols.
Example: {"type":"chart","id":"parab","props":{"kind":"function","alt":"A parabola y = a times x squared, opening wider as a shrinks","expr":"a * x^2","sliders":[{"id":"a","label":"Steepness","min":0.1,"max":3,"value":1}],"xLabel":"x","yLabel":"y"}}

### diagram

At most 3 per spec.

Prefer `diagram` when a structure is the point: steps in a process, a hierarchy, a cycle, a timeline, relationships.
`kind` is flow, tree, cycle, timeline, graph or labelled. `shape` (rect, round, diamond, circle) is optional and applies to every node.
Up to 30 nodes (id, label up to 60 chars) and 50 edges (from, to, optional label up to 40 chars); every edge must use node ids. `alt` is required: say what the diagram shows.
Example: {"type":"diagram","id":"water","props":{"kind":"cycle","alt":"The water cycle: evaporation, condensation, rain","nodes":[{"id":"sea","label":"Sea"},{"id":"cloud","label":"Cloud"},{"id":"rain","label":"Rain"}],"edges":[{"from":"sea","to":"cloud","label":"evaporates"},{"from":"cloud","to":"rain"},{"from":"rain","to":"sea"}]}}

### game

At most 2 per spec.

Use `game` when the learner should practise a concept by doing it: sequencing, loops, debugging. Every game has `title` (up to 60 chars), `goalText` (up to 200), `alt` (required, up to 400: say how to play and what it teaches), `hints` (up to 3, each up to 160 chars), `shell` ({} or {"lives": 1 to 5}) and `kind`, an object whose own `kind` picks the game. Kinds: "grid" (see below). a robot on a w by h grid (1 to 10 each; x and y count from 0, y 0 is the top row, "up" is y - 1) goes from `start` {x, y, dir: up, down, left or right} to `goal` {x, y}, past `walls` (up to 60 cells), and must pick every gem in `gems` (up to 10 cells) before it reaches the goal, which ends the run. Cells never overlap and the start is never the goal. `commands` is the palette, some of forward, left, right, pick. A program is a list of commands and repeat blocks {"repeat": 2 to 9, "body": [up to 6 commands]}; repeats need `allowRepeat` {"maxTimes", "maxBody"} and never nest. Optional `maxBlocks` caps program size (a repeat counts as 1 plus its body): use it to make a loop necessary. `mode` is watch (play the solution), solve (the learner builds a program) or debug (the learner fixes `starter`, a program with one bug). `maxSteps` (1 to 60) caps the commands run. Always include `solution`, a program that reaches the goal with every gem; a puzzle that cannot be solved is rejected. Drag kinds (the learner drags items and taps to place them, no program): {"kind":"order","items":[2 to 8 items, listed in the right order top to bottom]}; {"kind":"match","pairs":[2 to 8 {"left","right"} pairs, each left item has one right partner]}; {"kind":"sort","buckets":[2 to 4 group names],"cards":[2 to 10 {"text","bucket"} where bucket is the index of its group]}, with every bucket holding at least one card. Use drag kinds for ordering steps, matching terms to definitions, and sorting examples into groups.
Example: {"type":"game","id":"robot","props":{"title":"Get the gem","goalText":"Pick up the gem, then reach the flag.","alt":"Build a program for a robot on a 4 by 3 grid: drive right to a gem, pick it, then turn and drive down to the flag. Practises putting steps in order.","hints":["Pick the gem before you turn."],"shell":{"lives":3},"kind":{"kind":"grid","size":{"w":4,"h":3},"start":{"x":0,"y":0,"dir":"right"},"goal":{"x":3,"y":2},"walls":[{"x":1,"y":1}],"gems":[{"x":3,"y":0}],"commands":["forward","left","right","pick"],"mode":"solve","maxSteps":12,"solution":["forward","forward","forward","pick","right","forward","forward"]}}}

### image

At most 4 per spec.

Use `image` to show an existing picture from the asset library: {"source":"asset","assetId":"<id>","alt":"...","caption":"..."}.
Only use an assetId you were given. `alt` is required: describe what the picture shows. `caption` is optional.
The "generate" source is not available yet; do not use it.
Example: {"type":"image","id":"pic","props":{"source":"asset","assetId":"ast_pizza","alt":"A pizza cut into 8 equal slices","caption":"8 slices"}}

Props schema:

```json
{"type":"object","properties":{"source":{"type":"string","const":"asset"},"assetId":{"type":"string","pattern":"^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$"},"alt":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":200},"caption":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":200}},"required":["source","assetId","alt"],"additionalProperties":false}
```

### scene3d

At most 2 per spec.

Use `scene3d` for spatial or 3D structure: cells, atoms, geometry, models of objects. Do not use it for flat charts (use `chart`) or 2D drawings (use `stage`). `alt` is required: say what the scene shows. `primitives` (up to 60, labels included) have id, kind (sphere, box, cylinder, cone, torus, plane, arrow, line, label), position [x,y,z] each -10 to 10, size 0.05 to 5, color (theme colour), material (matte, glossy, wire), optional label (up to 40 chars; label kind needs it) and optional rotation [x,y,z] in degrees (-360 to 360). Optional `groups` (up to 10, one level) are {id, name, children: primitive ids}. `camera` is front, top, side, iso; `lights` is soft, bright, dim; `controls` (default true) lets the learner orbit. Optional `timeline` (up to 30 steps) uses the stage format; prop is one of position, rotation, color, opacity: opacity is 0 to 1, color is a theme colour, position and rotation are a string "x,y,z" using the same ranges.
Example: {"type":"scene3d","id":"cell","props":{"alt":"A plant cell with a nucleus inside","primitives":[{"id":"wall","kind":"box","position":[0,0,0],"size":4,"color":"green","material":"wire"},{"id":"nuc","kind":"sphere","position":[0,0,0],"size":1,"color":"pink","material":"glossy","label":"Nucleus"}],"groups":[{"id":"cell","name":"Cell","children":["wall","nuc"]}],"camera":"iso","lights":"soft","timeline":{"steps":[{"caption":"The whole cell","durationMs":1000,"set":[]},{"caption":"The nucleus moves aside","durationMs":1500,"set":[{"id":"nuc","prop":"position","value":"1,0,0"}]}]}}}

### stage

At most 3 per spec.

Use `stage` for a small animated 2D scene. `alt` is required: say what the scene shows. `shapes` (up to 60) sit on a 0-100 by 0-100 canvas; every number is 0 to 100. Each shape has id, kind (rect, circle, ellipse, line, text), x, y, optional fill and stroke (theme colours) and optional label (up to 40 chars). rect and ellipse need w and h (rect x,y is its top-left), circle needs r, line needs x2 and y2, text needs label.
Optional `timeline` (up to 30 steps): each step has caption, durationMs (300 to 4000) and set, a list of {id, prop, value} using shape ids. prop is one of x, y, opacity, fill, stroke, w, h, r: numbers 0 to 100 (opacity 0 to 1), fill and stroke are theme colours.
Example: {"type":"stage","id":"ball","props":{"alt":"A ball rolls from the left to the right of the ground","shapes":[{"id":"ground","kind":"rect","x":0,"y":80,"w":100,"h":20,"fill":"green"},{"id":"ball","kind":"circle","x":15,"y":72,"r":8,"fill":"sun","stroke":"ink","label":"Ball"}],"timeline":{"steps":[{"caption":"The ball starts on the left","durationMs":1000,"set":[]},{"caption":"It rolls to the right","durationMs":1500,"set":[{"id":"ball","prop":"x","value":85}]}]}}}

### text

At most 6 per spec.

Use `text` for a short explanation, definition or caption that no other block covers.
`md` is plain text in paragraphs (blank line between them); only **bold** and *italic* are styled.
No HTML, no headings, lists or images. Links are shown as plain text, not clickable.
Example: {"type":"text","id":"intro","props":{"md":"A **fraction** shows part of a whole.\n\nThe bottom number says how many equal parts."}}

Props schema:

```json
{"type":"object","properties":{"md":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":2000}},"required":["md"],"additionalProperties":false}
```
